narrative.overview: Pe creste is a kitchen-table decision surface for Romanian Carpathian hikes. Photography sells the idea; stats close it. Massif → trail is the chapter model; difficulty color is a compare signal on hike cards. Chrome accent follows the theme: saffron on dark, terracotta on light. Sister site: House Moldovan.
keyCharacteristics: Massif atlas wayfinding with cobalt range tiles
Difficulty compare accents with text kickers
Shared film neutrals with EN; separate identity
dos: Do lead with massif atlas wayfinding.
Do keep stats scannable on cards and hike pages.
Do pair difficulty color with Romanian text labels.
Do treat GPX, map, elevation, and marcaje as core product.
Do keep waymark colors data-bound only.
donts: Don't ship impersonal trail boilerplate or brochure copy.
Don't organize the site as difficulty chapters.
Don't use Big Shoulders Display on this site.
Don't reuse waymark colors as chrome accents.
Don't treat this site and House Moldovan as one visual product.
